dedupe_keys.name: 9a amateur radio repeater tables of croatia hrvhf net

description: The 9A repeater page of hrvhf.net, a Croatian VHF amateur radio community site, lists the amateur radio repeaters of Croatia in tables for regional VHF and regional UHF repeaters. Each row gives the number, location, host site, Maidenhead locator, altitude above sea level, channel, output and input frequencies, call sign, equipment model, status and CTCSS subtone; for example Belje at JN95JS, 350 metres, channel RV50 on 145.625 and 145.025 MHz, call sign 9A0VBM, working. A colour legend marks repeaters that are faulty or switched off, under repair, under construction, planned, working without problems, or with a changed frequency, and the page links an interactive map made by a club member. Access is free and public; no licence is stated. Caveats: a note on the page says the tables are currently being updated, the list is kept by volunteers, and it is in Croatian. Coverage is Croatia. It supports emergency communications planning, such as mapping backup radio relays on mountain sites that can serve civil protection when mobile networks fail; related records are the Greek amateur voice repeater table and the NRRL Norway repeater list.
